description: KML export contract (KML mode, no icons). Folders follow layer order and are omitted when empty; hidden layers get <visibility>0</visibility>; objects on unknown layers follow the folders at document level. Within a folder, symbols precede drawings in store order. Styles appear in first-use order. Colours are KML aabbggrr; widths are portable points/dp with one decimal; coordinates are lon,lat with seven decimals (elevation one decimal). Text is XML-escaped and control characters other than tab/newline are dropped. Placemark ids are "tacmap-" plus the lowercase object id so they are valid XML IDs. Drawing coordinates are [lat, lon].
